panels.title: 📊 Resumo PLC Prometheus
panels.description: Tabela dos principais dados do PLC

targets.query: from(bucket: "processo") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and (r.name == "contador_bom" or r.name == "contador_ruim" or r.name == "maquina_ligada" or r.name == "AI_Corrente" or r.name == "AI_Vibracao" or r.name == "edge_up")) |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["name"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "contador_bom", "contador_ruim", "maquina_ligada", "AI_Corrente", "AI_Vibracao", "edge_up"]) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 30)

from(bucket: "processo") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.name == "edge_up") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "") |> last()

from(bucket: "processo") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.name == "maquina_ligada") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "") |> last()

from(bucket: "processo") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and (r.name == "contador_bom" or r.name == "contador_ruim")) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "") |> last() |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["name"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: if exists r.contador_bom and exists r.contador_ruim and (r.contador_bom + r.contador_ruim) > 0 then (float(v: r.contador_bom) / float(v: r.contador_bom + r.contador_ruim)) * 100.0 else 0.0 }))

from(bucket: "processo") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.name == "contador_bom") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "") |> last()

from(bucket: "processo") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.name == "contador_ruim") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "") |> last()

from(bucket: "processo") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and (r.name == "plc_read_ok_total" or r.name == "plc_read_fail_total" or r.name == "plc_read_latency_ms" or r.name == "edge_backlog_size")) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "") |> last() |> pivot(rowKey:["ip"], columnKey: ["name"], valueColumn: "_value")
